name: ticket-priority
description: Score a ticket across multiple priority dimensions for sprint planning. Replaces manual story pointing with calibrated multi-dimensional assessment.

question.instructions: How much business value does completing this ticket deliver? Consider: user impact, revenue impact, unblocking other work, compliance requirements.
How much engineering effort is required? Consider: number of files changed, cross-team dependencies, testing complexity, review burden.
Is this ticket blocking other tickets, other teams, or a release? Consider explicit blockers, implicit dependencies, and deadline pressure.
How risky is this change? Consider: touches production, affects auth/payments, involves data migration, changes shared infrastructure.
Is this primarily a tech debt / refactoring / maintenance ticket rather than a feature or bug fix?
